page.overview:
Who is Blue Face of Udolpho?

The Blue Face of Udolpho is one of the many spirits forced to dwell in the hamlet of Udolpho, a haunted manor in the north of the principality of Miragliano in Tilea, due to a terrible curse that hangs over the estate and compels its guests to become one with an endless melodrama.

The blue face that haunts the estate and its surroundings is possibly connected to the ghostly blue visage of Montoni Udolpho that haunts House Udolpho's patriarch, Old Melmoth.
